basic_details.job_title: CDO Uttarkashi Ombudsman Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Applicants must not be more than 68 years of age.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | ombudsman: Minimum 10 years of experience in public administration, law, education, social service, or management. Experience of working with a lok or community organisation is mandatory. Must be physically and mentally fit.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 2,250 per meeting (Maximum Rs. 45,000 per month)
salary_details.ombudsman: Rs. 2,250 per meeting, subject to a maximum of Rs. 45,000 per month
salary_details.details: The official notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits.

selection_process: The selection process consists of scrutiny of applications and bio-data at the district level for consideration and recommendation by a selection committee based on performance
followed by appointment approved at the government level.
how_to_apply: Download the application format and notification from the official website.
Fill out the personal information and professional information in the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates, age proof, and residence proof.
Attach a medical fitness certificate regarding physical and mental fitness to conduct field visits.
Attach a personal affidavit certified by a notary public confirming you are not a member of a political party.
Attach a personal declaration certified by a notary public stating you have not been convicted or chargesheeted in a criminal case.

Send the completed application form along with all enclosures via registered post to the Office of Chief Development Officer Uttarkashi, Room No. 216, Vikas Bhavan, MGNREGA Cell on or before 28 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Any member of a political party or affiliated organisation is not eligible to apply. Applicants must submit a declaration regarding non-involvement in political parties and criminal cases. Applications received after 28 October 2026 (5:00 PM) will not be considered under any circumstances. The tenure is for 2 years or up to 68 years of age, whichever is earlier, and can be extended year by year for up to two years based on work performance. Re-appointment is not permitted. The state government may remove the Ombudsman based on unsatisfactory work performance upon the selection committee's recommendation.
